library.help: Reads the .txt and .md files (UTF-8 text) in the chosen folder and all its subfolders. A file NAME.txt.manifest.toml next to a text can give its title, punctuation conventions and date (era = "唐", year = 618, year_end = 907); otherwise the file name is the title. Other formats, such as Excel, are not read.

source.label: Search in
source.itkc.note: Searches ITKC's classical originals (Classical Texts and the Korean Literary Collections) online. ITKC returns excerpts of about 150 characters around the hits, cut at both ends, so results show only what the excerpt contains; the title opens the record on ITKC. The first 100 records per collection are checked. Nothing is stored.
error.itkc_alternatives: ITKC search takes one word per box, without |.
error.itkc_query: ITKC search takes words combined with AND, NOT, "phrase" or NEAR/n; OR and /regex/ are not available for ITKC.
error.source_failed: The online source did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
error.source_cap: The request limit for this session has been reached (200 requests). Restart the window to search again.
source.ndl.note: Searches the OCR text of NDL's classical books (NDL Lab). NDL finds only phrases of two or more characters, so the longer element (or the longest word) is sent and the rest is checked here. NDL returns unpunctuated OCR excerpts that may contain recognition errors, cut at both ends; check the page image through the title link before citing. The first 50 books are checked. Nothing is stored.
source.ndl.summary: NDL: {books} of {total} books found for {phrase} checked
error.ndl_short: NDL finds only phrases of two or more characters. Make at least one element two characters long, or search ITKC or your text folder.
error.ndl_alternatives: NDL is asked for one element as a phrase: at least one box must hold a single word, without |.
error.ndl_query: NDL search takes words combined with AND, NOT, "phrase" or NEAR/n; OR and /regex/ are not available for NDL.
source.cbeta.note: Searches the CBETA Buddhist canon online (CBData API). The longer element (or the longest word) is sent, and CBETA returns excerpts of 40 characters around each hit; the rest is checked here. Interlinear notes are left out. The first 50 juan are checked, and the title opens the juan in CBETA Online. Texts: CBETA Chinese Electronic Tripitaka Collection, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial use, attribution, share alike). Nothing is stored.
source.cbeta.summary: CBETA: {juans} of {total} juan found for {phrase} checked
error.cbeta_alternatives: CBETA is asked for one element as a phrase: at least one box must hold a single word, without |.
error.cbeta_query: CBETA search takes words combined with AND, NOT, "phrase" or NEAR/n; OR and /regex/ are not available for CBETA.
source.docusky.note: Searches the 佛寺志靈應故事 public database on DocuSky: selected stories from 普陀洛迦新志 and 清涼山志, not the complete books. One element or word is sent; the first 50 returned records are checked here. Only isolated source paragraphs are searched; research tags and unsupported bodies are excluded. Titles open the project page. Compiler: 曹德啓; data: 中華佛學研究所; platform: 臺灣大學數位人文研究中心. Personal, non-commercial research use under the provider's terms. Nothing is stored.
source.docusky.summary: DocuSky: {accepted} checked, {excluded} excluded from {records} of {total} records found for {phrase}
error.docusky_alternatives: DocuSky is asked for one element: at least one box must contain a single word without |.
error.docusky_query: DocuSky supports AND, NOT, "phrase" and NEAR/n here, with at least one positive word containing only letters or numbers. OR and /regex/ are unavailable.
source.cyberseodang.note: Searches the Dongyang Classics DB (Cyber Seodang) of the Institute of Traditional Culture via its Open API. The server returns records with titles, descriptions and article links. Results display the returned text with links to the original articles on Cyber Seodang; full body text and context are not guaranteed, and the distinction between original classical text and translation in returned fields remains unverified, so unverified records are kept as candidates. Up to 50 records are checked. Nothing is stored.
source.cyberseodang.summary: Cyber Seodang: {items} of {total} records found for {phrase} checked
error.cyberseodang_alternatives: Cyber Seodang search is asked for one element as a phrase: at least one box must hold a single word, without |.
error.cyberseodang_query: Cyber Seodang search takes words combined with AND, NOT, "phrase" or NEAR/n; OR and /regex/ are not available for Cyber Seodang.
